component.name: PenguinBurner
component.summary: Automatic NVIDIA GPU undervolting, overclocking and per-game tuning

description.p: PenguinBurner tunes NVIDIA GPUs on Linux automatically. One Auto-UV scan sweeps the card under a managed headless Q2RTX benchmark plus a CUDA load, verifies stability and FPS per watt at single voltage/frequency bin precision, and saves three profiles: Efficiency, Balanced and Performance (undervolt plus overclock). On a verified RTX 5080 the Balanced tier held roughly the stock loaded clock at 272 W instead of 341 W.

ul.li: Adaptive undervolting that switches between the saved tiers while you play to hold your frame-rate target, and eases off on frame caps and idle desktops.
A Game Library that brings Steam, Lutris and Heroic games into one list, each with its own GPU profile, adaptive FPS target and overlay setting, applied at launch and restored on exit.
An in-game Vulkan overlay showing base FPS, frame-generation FPS, PC latency, clocks, power, temperatures and the active tier.
Manual V/F and fan curve editors, an automatic silent fan curve, MSI Afterburner profile import and LACT config export.
A Qt desktop UI and a CLI, both driving one root systemd service (penguin-burnerd, a compiled Rust daemon) installed once with a single admin prompt.

description.p: Pre-optimized Auto-UV targets are included for RTX 30, 40 and 50 series cards. GPU tuning can crash the driver or freeze the system; use it at your own risk.
